about: The Seam Room's zones. Each zone is a real page. A zone is a box on the floor (x, z in metres; a missing side is open-ended). Where two boxes touch is a seam; a doorway is just a small zone box set in a wall opening. seam.js reads this through Seam.fromData(). room.js and agent/room-agent.mjs both read it, so a new zone added here is known to the room, the URL switching and the AI character at once. `walk` is the floor you can stand on (rectangles; a rectangle with `door` is a doorway, passable only while that door is open, and it is shrunk by the walker's radius in x only; `links` names the two floors it joins, which the AI uses to route through doors). `module` is the file that builds a zone's scene (room.js import()s it); `v` is its version: bump it when you change that module. A room that is open notices a new or changed zone here within about 20 s and builds it without a reload (room.js, "new rooms without a reload"). A door with a "future" kind is a closed coming-soon decoration; change its kind to "door" (with its zone + walk rectangle) and it opens for real.

zones.label: F
zones.name: Gym
zones.title: Seam Room · Gym (Page F) - Heartbeat Observatory
zones.note: The gym behind the media room's side door (d-side, next to the bookshelf). 24 m x 34 m x 9.5 m inside (x -32.4..-8.4, z -10.15..23.85), a full 28 x 15 m court along z (centre x -18.9, z 6.85), hoops at z -5.575 and 19.275, bleachers on the west wall. zones.label: G
zones.name: Hallway
zones.title: Seam Room · Hallway (Page G) - Heartbeat Observatory
zones.note: The long hallway behind the media room's back door (d-back, right of the desk). 3 m wide x 40 m long x 2.9 m tall inside (x -4.45..-1.45, z 9.7..49.7), running north, with a window at the far end. Ten future doors g-1..g-10 along it, alternating east (x -1.45) and west (x -4.45) walls, each with a big number. Built by hallway.js in the same scene as the room.

zones.label: H
zones.name: Closet
zones.title: Seam Room · Closet (Page H) - Heartbeat Observatory
zones.note: A walk-in closet behind hallway door 1 (g-1, east wall). 2.5 m wide x 3 m deep x 2.6 m tall inside (x -1.3..1.2, z 11.5..14.5). Shirts double-hung on the south wall, coats on the north wall, shelves of boxes above both, a shoe rack under a mirror on the east wall, a laundry basket, a pull-chain bulb. Built by closet.js in the same scene as the room. Clear of the garage (x 2.15+, z up to 10.35).

zones.label: I
zones.name: Music Studio
zones.title: Seam Room · Music Studio (Page I) - Heartbeat Observatory
zones.note: A home recording studio behind hallway door 2 (g-2, west wall, barn red). 3.65 m wide x 9.4 m deep x 2.7 m tall inside (x -8.25..-4.6, z 12.0..21.4). Control room (south): desk facing the booth glass with a mixing desk, a screen (session: First Light), two monitors on stands, an office chair, a pad controller that plays a WebAudio beat (kick, snap, hats, bass; made in code) when tapped; a couch under wood diffusers and a 'first light' neon, a guitar on a stand, a credenza with a turntable and records, foam, bass traps, a rug. Glass partition at z 18.3..18.42 with a window and an open doorway (x -5.65..-4.6) into the vocal booth (mic, pop filter, headphones, lyric stand). Built by studio.js in the same scene as the room. The gym's wall is at x -8.4..-8.25.
